papers.title: Gap Filling of 3-D Microvascular Networks by Tensor Voting
papers.authority_decision: Context only. This paper specifies a 3-D segmented-network token pipeline, not the planned response-plus-theta 2-D helper.

contract_decisions.input: finite nonnegative 2-D response and same-shaped finite axial tangent theta in Cartesian radians, x right and y up
contract_decisions.encoding: T0 = response * n * n^T with n=(-sin(theta), cos(theta))
contract_decisions.active_tokens: source l1-l2 > 0, equivalent to positive response after rank-1 encoding
contract_decisions.self_vote: retain T0 and include the voting-field center, yielding T0 plus one cast self-vote
contract_decisions.support: exact source odd window derived from the 0.01 decay cutoff
contract_decisions.boundary: zero extension with out-of-image votes discarded by crop
contract_decisions.accumulation: float64, MATLAB find column-major voter order
contract_decisions.outputs: unnormalized stick=l1-l2 and ball=l2 from the accumulated symmetric tensor
contract_decisions.wrapper: deferred because image-to-orientation estimation is not part of the selected source
contract_decisions.detector: deferred; later cost/evidence mapping is a separate PhenoTypic adaptation
